title: JN Data is a jointly owned operations and hosting utility, not a builder
content:
JN Data is a jointly owned operations and hosting utility, not a builder. That is a disqualifier rather than a low score: the firm's mandate is to run systems on behalf of its owners, so there is no development practice for a partnership to attach to.

The distinction is worth keeping sharp, because a shared Nordic IT utility looks superficially like the bank-owned cooperatives elsewhere in this set. The cooperatives at least build; an operations utility consumes what others build. No open-source screen will change that, which makes this note a closing judgement rather than a research gap.
